Lodging and Travel Reimbursement Information for the Head IT Advisory Board Meeting

Below are links and contact information for the Estancia Hotel and the La Jolla Beach and Tennis Club. You must ask for the UCSD rate in order for UCSD to reimburse your hotel expenses. The UCSD rate at the Estancia is $159/night, and the La Jolla Beach and Tennis Club is $119/night, while available. Please book your hotel as soon as possible to get the discounted rate during this Memorial Day week event.

Map and Directions

Map (PDF)

Here is the recommended route to SDSC.

  • Take Interstate 5.
  • Exit Genesee, turn West off exit. (From the south, turn left. From the north, turn right).
  • At the top of the hill, turn left at North Torrey Pines Road.
  • At the first light, turn left on Northpoint Drive into UCSD.
  • Follow Northpoint Drive past the campus Information Booth.
  • Continue on Northpoint as it turns right and becomes Hopkins Drive.
  • Turn right on Voigt Drive (South of RIMAC and SDSC).
  • Enter the Hopkins Parking structure from the top of the hill (pass the structure, turn right, then right again to enter Level 6).
  • Turn right at the overhead sign that reads “Accessible Parking”
  • Find a visitor parking space on Level 7 of the Hopkin’s Parking Structure.
  • Cross the footbridge at the north/west corner of Level 7 and turn right in the Social Sciences Building breezeway.
  • Turn right at the curved sidewalk to the west entrance to the SDSC.
  • After entering the building, walk east and go down the stairs.
SCCN is on the left-hand side of the building. You will see our sign in the glass door.
Swartz Center for Computational Neuroscience
Institute for Neural Computation, UC San Diego
9500 Gilman Drive # 0559, La Jolla, CA 92093-0559
